channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: New Okinawa governor rejects unconditional defense buildup
item.description: "I will not unconditionally accept" the defense buildup in the region, Gov. Koja said in an inaugural news conference at his office in Naha.

item.title: U.K.’s path back to the EU will hit hard post-Brexit realities
item.description: New U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham touched off a flurry of speculation that he may campaign to re-enter the EU.

item.title: Kyoto plans to introduce dual pricing for World Heritage castle
item.description: The admission fee will be revised down to ¥1,000 from ¥1,300 for Kyoto residents and raised to ¥2,000 for visitors from outside the city.

item.title: Ex-GSDF member admits trespassing at Chinese embassy in Tokyo
item.description: According to the indictment, Kodai Murata, 24, entered the embassy grounds on March 24 carrying a kitchen knife with an 18-centimeter blade.

item.title: Last working engine of Hayabusa2 asteroid probe breaks down
item.description: The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency aims to continue the mission by employing usable parts of two other failed ion engines on Hayabusa2.

item.title: Japan mayor who took maternity leave named to Time’s list of most influential
item.description: Shoko Kawata, the mayor of Yawata, Kyoto Prefecture, was named to the magazine's list of Most Influential Rising Stars.

item.title: Japan’s Kondo siblings capture gold in judo at Asian Games
item.description: Adding to Japan's ever-growing gold medal haul at the quadrennial sporting event, Sorato Anraku stood atop the men's boulder podium in sport climbing.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

item.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
item.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.
